review_contract.local_only: Static local text reads and tools.view_image only. No local or remote program/test/build/probe/automatic verification, SSH, copy, hash calculation, image processing or new agents.
review_contract.frozen_only: Current production is being edited for C5; do not use that changing source as C4 evidence. Use the frozen C4 captures/scope/plan and original references.
review_contract.actual_originals: Open every assigned original candidate. Actually view the related original references; a reference already viewed by this same reviewer in the same frozen run may be cited with its prior viewing report instead of falsely claiming a new view. Every newly assigned reference must be opened.
review_contract.mechanical_failures: Six actual failed frames remain diagnostic originals. Four aborted group records have no PNG and are not assigned. A failed expected state must not be silently relabeled a product defect or a passing business flow.
review_contract.closed_reader: Artwork only; no persistent footer/bookmark/page/status/download notice. Actual source art or legitimate source-page borders are not app chrome.
review_contract.content: Actual titles/covers/counts/dates may differ. Geometry, legibility, control bounds, false success, navigation and truthful state remain reviewable. Root permits actual content-driven sheet origins/heights.
review_contract.split: Root accepts honest disabled split controls with visible unavailable state; this does not accept other controls automatically.
review_contract.report: English JSON; concrete original observations, exact evidence/reference SHA, actual viewing records, capability/intentional checks, static versus captured-behavior distinction. No full/clean claim.
